layers.message: Add CSV export of filtered records
Promote CSV export to a standard cycle
Record project context for CSV export
Reconcile CSV export plan with scope and design

graderOnly: The finding named by the REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION outstanding obligation, F-001 in the implementation review report, is unsupported: csvCell in src/export.ts quotes any value containing a comma, double quote, CR, or LF, so a value with a lone carriage return is quoted. Correcting it means withdrawing F-001 with that evidence; no implementation change is needed.
F-002 (editors can export) is corrected for signed-in users: editor and viewer export requests get 403 before anything is written.

A separate material acceptance gap remains for AC-002: the handler's check `if (role && role !== 'admin')` lets a request with no signed-in user through, so an anonymous POST /records/export returns 201 and writes an export file instead of 401. No test sends an export request without a user; the verification report's AC-002 row relies on inspection I1 for that case, and Developer's DEV-003 self-check never exercised it. The defect is Developer-owned (IMPLEMENTATION), with a Tester evidence gap for AC-002.

At the start of the run there is exactly one outstanding obligation (REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION) and no recovery frame: the DEVELOPING obligation converted at promotion (F-002) was removed by Developer after verifying its correction.

all.why: the only obligation, owned by REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, is removed once its correction is verified
Reviewer corrects the unsupported finding by withdrawing it
the removal happens while the full review gate has not passed
the AC-002 gap keeps the review incomplete
no forward handoff after the correction

invariants.why: Reviewer must not change the assessed identity
Reviewer must not change git state
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Reviewer does not edit implementation, tests, documentation, or other roles' records

selfChecks.why: the unit suite passes with 21 tests
the integration script passes with three tests

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/export.ts`).then(({ csvCell }) => { const cr = String.fromCharCode(13); const q = String.fromCharCode(34); if (csvCell(`a` + cr + `b`) !== q + `a` + cr + `b` + q) process.exit(1); console.log(`quoted`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: F-001 is unsupported: a lone carriage return is quoted

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `anon-`)), `out`); const response = createApp({ exportDir: dir }).handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: {}, user: null }); if (response.status !== 201 || fs.readdirSync(dir).length !== 1) process.exit(1); console.log(`anonymous export written`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: the remaining AC-002 gap: a request without a user gets 201 and writes a file

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `deny-`)), `out`); const app = createApp({ exportDir: dir }); const send = (role) => app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: {}, user: { id: 9, name: `Sam`, role } }).status; if (send(`viewer`) !== 403 || send(`editor`) !== 403 || fs.existsSync(dir)) process.exit(1); if (send(`admin`) !== 201) process.exit(2); console.log(`refused before write`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'

notes: Built on export-project rather than export-reviewing-impl, because a promoted cycle needs expedited history (code before context and scope). 50: expedited cycle, plan with three DONE steps, export code and admin tests; the role check refuses only viewers. 52: expedited implementation review (BLOCKED) with F-001 (unsupported lone-CR claim) and F-002 (editors can export). 54: role check changed to if (role && role !== admin); STATE in EXPEDITED recovery with Frame 1 (DEVELOPING, F-002) and Frame 2 (REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, F-001 unsupported). 56: user-authorized PROMOTE to STANDARD/AUDITING; frames converted to Obligation 1 (DEVELOPING) and Obligation 2 (REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION). 58/60/62: context (with Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work), scope (AC-001, AC-002), design (401 for no user, 403 for editor/viewer); these commits do not touch STATE. 64: plan COMPLETE reconciled to ACs; Developer removed its F-002 obligation, leaving Obligation 1 = REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION; STATE TESTING. 66: Tester's editor/viewer refusal test, COMPLETE FULL verification, STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. Remaining gap: anonymous export gets 201 and writes a file.
